mapper.sql: select w.webhook_id, w.name, w.url, case when w.secret_enc is not null and w.secret_enc <> '' then true else false end as secret_configured, w.event_type, w.payload_template, w.retry_count, w.timeout_ms, w.enabled, d.status as last_delivery_status, d.http_status as last_http_status, d.create_time as last_delivery_time, w.create_time, w.update_time from crm_outbound_webhook w left join lateral ( select status, http_status, create_time from crm_outbound_webhook_delivery where tenant_id = w.tenant_id and webhook_id = w.webhook_id order by create_time desc limit 1 ) d on true
mapper.select: select webhook_id, tenant_id, name, url, secret_enc, event_type, payload_template, retry_count, timeout_ms, enabled, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from crm_outbound_webhook where del_flag = '0' and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and enabled = '1' and event_type = #{eventType}
select count(1) from crm_outbound_webhook where del_flag = '0' and tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.update:
update crm_outbound_webhook
name = #{name}, url = #{url}, secret_enc = #{secretEnc}, event_type = #{eventType}, payload_template = #{payloadTemplate}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, timeout_ms = #{timeoutMs}, enabled = #{enabled}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime},
where webhook_id = #{webhookId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0'
update crm_outbound_webhook set del_flag = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where webhook_id = #{webhookId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0'
